description: Source code for managing neighboring access point data collection, including threading, list management, and communication with hardware/software components for WiFi neighbor data harvesting.

classes.name: neighboringapdata
classes.description: Data structure representing neighboring AP information, including timestamp, radio name, number of APs, and related data.

methods.name: StartNeighboringAPHarvesting
methods.description: Thread function that periodically collects neighboring AP data, manages reporting periods, and triggers data reporting.

methods.name: add_to_nap_list
methods.description: Adds neighboring AP data to a linked list.

methods.name: print_nap_list
methods.description: Prints the current list of neighboring AP data.

methods.name: delete_nap_list
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the neighboring AP linked list.

methods.name: GetRadioNeighboringAPData
methods.description: Retrieves neighboring AP data for a specific radio interface.

methods.name: _napsyscmd
methods.description: Executes a system command and captures its output.

methods.name: WaitForPthreadConditionTimeoutNAP
methods.description: Waits for a specified period or until signaled, used for polling intervals.

methods.name: SetNAPHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables the neighboring AP harvesting thread.

methods.name: GetNAPHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Returns whether harvesting is enabled.

methods.name: SetNAPReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period for neighboring AP data.

methods.name: GetNAPReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period.

methods.name: SetNAPPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling interval for data collection.

methods.name: GetNAPPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling interval.

methods.name: SetNAPReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period.

methods.name: GetNAPReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default reporting period.

methods.name: SetNAPPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling interval.

methods.name: GetNAPPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default polling interval.

methods.name: GetNAPOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the current TTL override value.

methods.name: SetNAPOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the TTL override value.

methods.name: GetNAPOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default TTL override value.

methods.name: ValidateNAPPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a given period is valid within predefined neighbor AP periods.
